original_ai_output.title_zh: Globeleq与投资者洽谈重组莫桑比克天然气项目融资
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 独立电力生产商Globeleq预计将在年底前与投资者敲定重组后的融资方案，涉及其在莫桑比克6.6亿美元的天然气项目。该公司驻莫桑比克国家经理Samir Sale表示，450兆瓦的Temane燃气电站预计2028年全面投运，较原计划推迟三年。此前两场气旋损坏设备并淹没工地，2024年选举后的政治暴力也加剧了延误。

key_facts.fact: Globeleq预计年底前敲定莫桑比克天然气项目的重组融资方案
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Globeleq expects to finalise a restructured financing package with investors for its $660 million gas project in Mozambique by year-end

key_facts.fact: 450兆瓦Temane燃气电站预计2028年全面投运，较原计划推迟三年
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The 450 megawatt gas-fired Temane plant is expected to be fully operational in 2028, three years behind schedule

key_facts.fact: 两场气旋损坏设备并淹没工地，2024年选举后的政治暴力也导致工期延误
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: two separate cyclones damaged equipment and flooded the site, while post-election violence across the southern African country in 2024 also contributed to delays
The project is located in Inhambane province

uncertainties: 融资重组方案尚未最终敲定，预计年底前完成
目前仅单一来源（路透社经Club of Mozambique转载）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
